evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, and performance tuning
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize data quality frameworks, governance best practices, and accuracy/security with no velocity-oriented language present.
evidence.domain_risk: Manage and maintain data warehouses and data lakes, ensuring accuracy, availability, and security
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The JD is generic about sector and does not name financial, regulatory, or public-facing consequences — errors would affect internal business decisions, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: foster a culture of collaboration and technical excellence within the data team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing data team with junior engineers to mentor and established warehouses/lakes to maintain indicates a mid-maturity function, not built from zero.
evidence.jd_authorship: Familiarity with data warehousing technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) and ETL tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Talend, Fivetran)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The requirements list is broad and generic ('familiarity with', 'knowledge of', 'is a plus' across many tool categories) reading as a template job posting rather than describing precise daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and data scientists to translate business needs into technical solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary named partners are other data-function roles (data analysts, data scientists) rather than a specific commercial, product, or finance audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Support the development of dashboards, reports, and analytical models to provide actionable insights
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities are framed around supporting, contributing to, and managing existing systems rather than defining strategy or direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-enabling data work is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, and performance tuning
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality frameworks are named as an implementation responsibility, but the generic, templated phrasing throughout the JD (broad tool lists, vague 'best practices') reads closer to a listed capability than a deeply owned practice.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Manage and maintain data warehouses and data lakes, ensuring accuracy, availability, and security
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Accuracy, availability, and security are named concerns but framed as routine management responsibilities rather than a dominant compliance/regulatory risk narrative, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and ETL processes... Manage and maintain data warehouses and data lakes
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both designs new pipelines and maintains existing warehouses/lakes, a genuine mix of greenfield and fix/scale work.
evidence.urgency: Interested candidates are requested to send in their cover letter and resume clarifying their work experience and expected salary to hrd@ycotek.com.np by 09 September 2026
evidence.loss_aversion: ensuring accuracy, availability, and security — reliability framing present but generic and not compliance-specific.
